name: NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU
bandwidth_basis: PER LANE, PER DIRECTION. 800 Gb/s = 100 GB/s per direction per port.
topology: Standard Ethernet or InfiniBand switched fabric.
switching: Combines Vera CPU with ConnectX-9 networking. Scale-in networking for agentic AI factories. Hardware accelerators for security, data movement, tenant isolation.
notes: BlueField-4 is the current flagship DPU at 800 Gb/s. Product page states it is an '800 Gb/s infrastructure platform for gigascale AI factories' delivering 'powerful computing and accelerations for networking, data storage, and cybersecurity.' Combines NVIDIA Vera CPU with ConnectX-9 networking. BlueField-4 STX storage processor variant for AI-native storage. The DPU doubles per-port bandwidth over BlueField-3.
